method: Human-readable publisher pages opened with web tools; facts below are concise paraphrased extractions, not full archived source pages. Each source extraction stays below 200 words. Mutable URLs require revalidation before a real commercial decision.

sources.title: BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook: software developers
limits: Occupation wages exclude the full employer cost of benefits and overhead.
Industry medians are not wages of SignalTree buyers.
Annual wages divided by assumed work hours and a broad benefits factor are scenario estimates, not measured developer hourly compensation.

sources.title: BLS Employer Costs for Employee Compensation
limits: Broad private-sector averages, not software-developer-specific benefits or business-reviewer rates.
Employer compensation is not automatically cash released when a task becomes faster.

sources.title: Aswath Damodaran: Margins by Sector (US)
sources.source_kind: primary published analysis of third-party financial data
limits: Author analysis uses multiple data services; it is primary published analysis, not primary company filings.
Sample company counts are not eligible buyers.
Sector margins are neither absolute profits nor account software budgets; private small firms may differ substantially.
Banking margins are not directly comparable with industrial accounting ratios.

sources.title: BEA Corporate Profits
limits: Macroeconomic context only. No portion is assigned to SignalTree.
An annual profit flow is not an addressable software budget or customer count.
Quarterly levels and annualized rates are deliberately excluded from scenario inputs.

sources.title: Langfuse pricing
sources.geography: Public USD pricing; region and tax terms may vary
limits: List-price anchor for a different and broader product, not evidence of SignalTree willingness to pay.
Base prices exclude excess usage and optional terms; public runtime adoption creates no subscription revenue.

sources.title: LangSmith plans and pricing
sources.geography: Public USD pricing; region and tax terms may vary

facts.value: pay as you go; product-specific meters

limits: Seat pricing and trace allowances are not account-equivalent to Langfuse or modeled SignalTree tiers.
Tracing, evaluation, hosting and agent services are not all replaced by local state coordination.

sources.title: Sentry pricing
sources.geography: Public USD pricing; region and tax terms may vary
limits: Base prices exclude metered usage, some add-ons, tax and contract terms.
Error monitoring and tracing overlap investigation tooling, but a state library does not replace the full service.

sources.title: Temporal Cloud pricing and support
sources.geography: Public USD pricing; region and tax terms may vary

facts.value: greater of USD 500/month or 10% of usage
durable workflow execution, event history, retries and operational support

limits: Main pricing page and current documentation agree; an older official AWS Marketplace acquisition page still advertises a USD 100 monthly plan fee.
Do not apply old Marketplace terms to this current standard price anchor.
This is a backend durable execution service, not a browser-state replacement.

sources.title: Temporal Cloud pricing documentation
sources.geography: Public USD pricing; region and tax terms may vary

facts.value: no base fee; 10% of usage spend
greater of USD 500/month or 10% of usage spend

limits: Corroborates current main pricing; included allocations and commitment pricing affect exact invoices.
No invoice-replacement benefit is assumed.

sources.title: Inngest pricing
sources.geography: Public USD pricing; region and tax terms may vary

facts.value: event-driven application and agent orchestration; durable execution and observability

limits: Excess usage and add-ons change total costs.
A workflow orchestration complement; no assumed displacement by SignalTree.

sources.title: Langfuse overview

facts.value: LLM and non-LLM tracing, sessions, prompt management, evaluation, cost/latency analysis, and AI Gateway
JavaScript/Python SDKs, framework integrations and OpenTelemetry

limits: Published feature descriptions are not independent performance or buyer-outcome measurements.
Runtime-owner correlation is a potential complementary context layer, not proof of replacing these products.

sources.title: OpenTelemetry: What is OpenTelemetry?

facts.value: vendor-neutral generation, export and collection of traces, metrics and logs
storage and visualization are left to other tools; OpenTelemetry is not an observability backend

limits: A transport or instrumentation integration would require actual implementation.
Compatibility does not establish present SignalTree support or saved customer effort.

sources.title: TanStack DB overview

facts.value: reactive client store, normalized collections, live queries and optimistic mutations
documentation includes SQLite persistence and offline transactions
documentation describes eager, on-demand and progressive modes

limits: Latest documentation may differ from the pinned DB 0.15.2 in the prior comparison.
Feature listings do not establish equivalent full semantics or measured performance.
Do not claim that peer libraries lack all transactional, persistent or optimistic capabilities.

sources.title: NgRx project license
limits: License fact only; no legal advice and no claim that adopting the library has zero engineering cost.

sources.title: TanStack DB project license
limits: License fact only; public runtime license fees are not a credible replacement-savings assumption.

sources.title: Cloudflare R2 pricing
sources.observation_period: Pricing observed November 18, 2026; page updated October 30, 2026
sources.geography: Public USD pricing; region and tax terms may vary
limits: A raw object-storage anchor only, not an actual Studio architecture or hosting quote.
Does not include compute, database/indexing, backup, availability, security, retention administration or labor.
Free tier, rounding and billing details must be applied to actual invoices.

exclusions: No buyer interviews, willingness-to-pay observations, adoption sample, churn study or SignalTree production incident-outcome study exists in this packet.
No market-size estimate or industry account count is inferred from listed-company samples, developer counts, vendor logos, downloads or global AI spending.
No competitor base subscription is assumed removable merely by adding SignalTree.
